name: Chameli
one_line: A 26-year-old woman who drives an auto-rickshaw through Lucknow between 10pm and 5am. Every episode is one passenger and one secret.
identity_block: Chameli, 26-year-old Indian woman, oval face, warm brown skin, thick straight black hair pulled into a low knot with a stray strand at the left temple, dark almond eyes, small mole below the right eye, straight nose, full lips, small silver nose stud on the left, single thin gold ring in each ear
wardrobe: faded olive-green kurta over dark jeans, a maroon shawl looped once around the neck, worn brown leather sandals, a steel watch on the left wrist
never_changes: the mole below the right eye
the silver nose stud on the left
the stray strand at the left temple
prop: black-and-yellow auto-rickshaw, small Hanuman idol on the dash, a string of dried marigold over the mirror, a cracked left rear-view mirror, sticker on the back reading maa ka aashirwad
style_tail: cinematic still, 9:16 vertical, shallow depth of field, sodium-vapour streetlight and warm dashboard glow, muted teal and amber, film grain, photorealistic, no text, no watermark
negative: text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, two people merged, cartoon, anime, oversaturated, plastic skin, western features

voice.speaker: meera
voice.direction: Low and unhurried, a little tired. First person, past tense, as if telling you this after the shift. Never explains the twist.

sets.auto_interior: interior of a black-and-yellow auto-rickshaw at night, warm dashboard glow from below, small Hanuman idol and dried marigold garland, rain beading on the windscreen
sets.night_street: empty wet Lucknow street at 2am, sodium-vapour streetlights, closed shop shutters, standing water reflecting the lights, no crowds
sets.destination: changes every episode; this is where the twist lives
